correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, any selected matching F of k nonincident cycle-boundary edges is crossing-neutral; deleting its endpoints preserves circular order and induces unrestricted matchings on 2(n-k) endpoints. Count F by M_{n,k}=2n/(2n-k) binom(2n-k,k), double count marked simple-edge subsets and expand t^S by binomial theorem. Normalizing gives factorial moments and from k=1,2 the exact covariance/correlation. For fixed k factorial coefficients tend to 1/k! and are bounded by 2/k!, so the published crossing marginal CLT plus dominated convergence yields independent N(0,1) and Pois(1) limit. Separately enumerated n=2..7 complete matchings and verified all deletion coefficients and finite moments by exact arithmetic.
residual_risks: Formula with n=1 is intentionally excluded, since the 2-vertex boundary cycle has degenerate duplicate edge descriptions; no new multivariate convergence rate is shown.
